```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement U02_4

| Condition | Requirement ID | Action |
|-----------|----------------|--------|
| Store requirements permanently and securely | REQ011 | Verify data persistence across system restarts |
| Handle change management of requirements | REQ012 | Validate that changes are tracked and retrievable |
| Associate requirements changes to existing developer identification | REQ013 | Check that each change is linked to a valid developer ID |
| Scalable to support thousands of requirements | REQ014 | Perform load test with 10,000+ requirements |
| Provide a lightweight installation method | REQ015 | Measure installation time and resource usage |

Notes:
- (-) indicates a "don't-care" condition where the value has no impact on the outcome.
- All conditions must be satisfied for the action to be triggered.
```

```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Verify permanent and secure storage of requirements",
    "req_ids": ["REQ011"],

      "storage_method": "encrypted_database"
    },

      "requirement_count": "10000"

    ],
```
